sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Semias is an Irish hero. He is a member of the Tuatha Dé Danann. The Tuatha came from four cities, each with its own master of wisdom. Semias was the master of the city of Murias. He owned a great cauldron of abundance. The cauldron fed every guest who came to it, no matter how many. He gave the cauldron to the god Dagda, the good father of the Tuatha. The gift made the cauldron a sacred object of the people. Later it became one of the four great treasures of Ireland. Each of those treasures came from one of the four cities, and each held a gift for the land.
